title: Platinum Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Platinum Account requirements: a $25,000 minimum opening deposit and a $50,000 ongoing minimum balance to maintain benefits, with daily interest compounding. It also states international wire transfer fees receive a 38% discount applied automatically when eligible.
faqs: What is the minimum opening deposit required for a Platinum Account?
